title: Preserve generic effect wrapper
description: Repair a tiny Scala project where a method incorrectly treats F[Option[User]] as Option[User].
expectedIntent: Preserve the outer F effect wrapper and inner Option while extracting the User name.
acceptablePatchFamilies: add a MapK context bound to getName and return F[Option[String]] using mapK over repo.find(id)
use the local MapK capability to transform inside F without erasing F or Option
intentNotes: Treating F[Option[User]] as Option[User] changes the intended effect semantics.
Specializing Main.getName to Box instead of keeping it generic changes the benchmark intent.
Unwrapping Box.value in generic code is not intent-preserving.
Dropping Option or using unsafe .get changes the intended absence semantics.
